review_id.description: The agent review the evolve notification names, such as r-12.

phase.description: reported ends the review with its verdict; applied reports an approved proposal pushed to Preview; discarded reports a declined, superseded or stale proposal whose change you discarded.

verdict.description: For reported only: proposal offers the change subagent's change; no_change ends the review without one.

agent_id.description: For a proposal: the task ID of the change subagent whose result holds .superverse/evolve/<review_id>/proposal.md, backtest.json and open-runs.json.

kind.description: For a proposal: change (the default), trial for a change history cannot judge, or undo to revert a live proposal named in undoes.

undoes.description: For an undo proposal only: the review of the live proposal it reverts.

title.description: For a proposal: one line in the goal's words, such as Follow up once instead of twice.

summary.description: For reported: what the review found, the proposal's why and its exact numbers, and findings without a proposal as noticed.

applied_commit.description: For applied only: the commit commit_and_push pushed the approved change as.
